title: Method moved from struct Circle into a plain extension Circle
expected: moved: area() leaves the struct body for the unconstrained extension of the same type; same meaning.

title: Method moved from the generic type body into extension Circle where Unit == Double
expected: Edited, never plain moved: doubled() now only exists when Unit == Double (decided context rule).

title: Method moved from extension Circle into extension Array where Element == Circle
expected: Edited, never plain moved: totalArea becomes a method on [Circle] instead of Circle (self and callers change).

title: Method moved between two plain extensions of the same type
expected: moved: area() goes from the first extension Circle to the second; both unconstrained, same meaning.

title: Default implementation in extension P edited; requirement in protocol P untouched
expected: Edited inside the default implementation only; the requirement is a separate declaration and pairs with nothing else.

title: Requirements reordered inside protocol P; default implementation unchanged
expected: Requirement lines move within the protocol body only (moved or reordered); nothing claimed on the extension.

title: @State var count -> @Binding var count
expected: Edited: the property wrapper changes ownership and behaviour; a name inside an attribute is never a rename.

title: Adding @Published to a stored property
expected: Edited: adding a wrapper changes behaviour; not reformatted, not renamed.

title: A property moves below its neighbour and loses its @AppStorage wrapper
expected: Edited (or movedWithEdit); never plain moved and never renamed, because the wrapper was removed.

title: scaled(by: Int) moved above scaled(by: Double)
expected: moved: the Int overload moves to the top, paired with itself (key scaled(by:Int)), not with the Double overload.

title: scaled(by: Int) -> scaled(by: Float)
expected: Edited: a parameter type change is a signature change (a different overload), not a rename.

title: Computed property: explicit get { } removed
expected: Edited in v1 (the spec keeps get-block vs shorthand as an edit); not reformatted, not moved.

title: Two statements of a computed getter extracted into a private method
expected: extractedFunction: the subtotal/total lines of summary's getter now live in discountedTotal(), which the getter calls.

title: Helper inlined into a function whose body was one implicit-return expression
expected: inlinedFunction: sum(_:) disappears and its body replaces the implicit-return call in total().

title: Function moved from the #if os(Linux) branch to the #else branch
expected: Edited, never plain moved: name() now compiles on every platform except Linux (decided context rule).

title: Function moved within the #if os(Linux) branch
expected: moved: name() (Linux version) moves below its siblings in the same branch; the #else name() is a different declaration and is untouched.

title: Function with a /** */ doc comment moved below its siblings
expected: moved: split(_:) together with its multi-line doc comment (the comment is attached, not deleted and re-added).

title: Property rename limit -> maxCount hides < becoming <= on the use line
expected: renamed on the declaration line only; the use line also changed < to <=, so a rename covering line 5 is false.

title: Method renamed isWithin -> fits with its one call site
expected: renamed: one name replaced consistently on the declaration and the call; nothing else changed.
